campaign.title: Discrete curvature resonance average in the remaining top-block core

resource_policy.literature_policy: No black-box theorem is presumed. Audit a primary source only if a non-elementary Weyl, completion, or resonance-spacing theorem is imported.

frozen_target.question: Can the discrete quadratic curvature resonances of the remaining intermediate-h, large-q top-block window be averaged over h to give the missing square-root aggregate bound, or is there a sharp actual-profile resonance obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: W_J^core=sum_(hq in J,q odd,h>L) chi_4(q) Omega_X^*(hq,h)(hq)^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xhq)), where Y asymp sqrt(X), |J|<=R asymp sqrt(Y), L=(log(2X))^B, q>=2sqrt(hq), h<=sqrt(hq)/2.
quantities: odd-q discrete first and second differences

completion_criteria: The exact odd-q phase and its discrete first and second differences are derived, including the character shift.
A legal exponential-sum bound for curvature larger than one is stated with its modulo-one resonance dependence, or a precise reason it cannot be used is proved.
The resonance parameter is averaged over the full residual h-range without taking termwise worst cases.
The actual profile, floor, hard-top, and star amplitudes are retained and their effect on completion or differencing is audited.
The resulting window estimate is propagated to the exact target sqrt(R) unweighted, or a sharp actual-profile family shows the missing capacity.
Perfect-fourth-power and near-rational curvature controls are explicit.
A clean statement-only derivation and an independent hostile gate exist.
No GAR, alpha, M9-M1, M9, or exponent promotion is made without the full residual-core estimate.

tasks.target: Derive and attack the averaged modulo-one curvature resonance sum over the exact intermediate-h, large-q core; prove a target window theorem or isolate a sharp resonance survivor.
required_output: exact averaged resonance theorem or no-go

tasks.target: Using only the Round-56 packet, independently derive the discrete curvature resonance interface and determine whether its averaged capacity can reach the sqrt(R) window target.
Try to falsify the averaged-resonance route at perfect fourth powers, rational curvatures, short intervals, profile edges, and completion boundaries; certify only a sharp lawful range.

review_seams.requirement: Large continuous second derivative is not itself cancellation on integers; retain the distance of the discrete increment or quadratic coefficient from integers.
Average the resonance loss over h before taking worst cases and preserve chi_4 plus the actual angular symbol.
Any completion or Weyl step must carry the true sampled profiles, floors, hard top, and stars with explicit boundary costs.
The blind proof sees only the Round-56 packet and its brief.
